unit.why: A single anecdote: the Lublin rabbi R. Azriel Horowitz presses the Seer of Lublin to give up leading a community, and the Seer's self-abasement only draws his followers closer.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הרה"ק מפרשיסחא בשם הרבי מלובלין
stories.summary_en: R. Azriel Horowitz, the 'Iron Head' of Lublin, urges the Seer of Lublin to tell his followers he is unworthy. The Seer's humble self-abasement only draws them closer. When the gaon then proposes that he claim to be a true tzaddik, the Seer refuses because he is no liar.
